styleLock.direction: technical dark-blue phone case commerce with orange accent callouts
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless cool white #FFFFFF sweep for the opening packshot, deep slate-blue #16324F gradient stage for protection and magnetic screens, light steel #DDE5EC field for detail and fit boards, warm mist grey #E8E4DE only in the closing slim-profile frame
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light near 6500K with one crisp edge rim tracing the bumper curve, controlled specular streaks on the translucent back, a soft cyan halo glow only where the magnetic charger attaches, never warm tungsten
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy seamless white sweep, brushed dark laminate ledges, fractured glass rubble confined to the single drop frame, matte steel info boards, no wood, no linen
styleLock.typography: one bold grotesque headline in white with at most one signal-orange #F26A1B lead word, every headline, pill and scale slot kept as an empty placeholder
styleLock.iconSystem: thin white circle-slash icons and blank indicator pills on hairline leader lines, one empty check disc and empty cross discs, no certification marks, no rating stars
styleLock.presentationRules: the cased phone keeps one consistent three-lens camera plateau silhouette and matte translucent back in every frame, the screen always reads as a blank dark glass with no clock or icons, the magnet ring stays a plain open ring with no logo
noDrift: no readable clock digits or interface icons on screen
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent technical dark-blue phone case ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool white #FFFFFF, graphite shell #22262C, deep slate-blue stage #16324F and signal-orange accent #F26A1B; cool high-key studio light near 6500K with one crisp edge rim along the bumper and a soft cyan halo only at the magnetic contact; white sweep, brushed dark laminate and matte steel boards only, fractured rubble confined to the single drop frame, no wood, no linen, no pastel stages; one bold grotesque headline kept as empty placeholder slots with at most one orange lead word; thin white circle-slash icons and blank pills on hairline leader lines; stable camera plateau silhouette with a blank dark glass screen and a plain open magnet ring; no color palette changes, no readable clock digits, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 冷白底三件立姿（正装机、悬空透明膜、背壳磁环），锁屏显示 19:51 与山脉壁纸；002 深场适配对照：左侧白色机型正装打勾（标注仅适配 6.9 寸 Pro Max 两代），右侧三张红色叉卡（6.3 寸 17、Air 6.5 寸、Pro 6.3 寸），机背有厂商标识；003 撞地护盾图：壳角触地碎玻璃四溅，蓝色护盾光膜包边，右列 3200+ 次跌落测试、10FT 高度、0% 损伤三行数字与军规标语，盾形小插图露出气囊角；004 加高围边特写：1.5mm 屏幕沿与 1.5mm 镜头圈两枚橙色数字胶囊引线标注，锁屏再现日期时间；005 磁吸充电：高俯背视，白色充电盘吸附磁环并发出青色光环，底部三小格（磁吸卡包、支架、车载出风口支架），小格屏幕仍带时间；006 手持透明背壳，右列三枚圆形禁止图标（防刮/防指纹/防油污）带英文字注；007 手持侧视+右侧侧颜插卡，0.05 英寸增量刻度与 Added 字样。品类判定依据：主体为磁吸无线充电兼容透明防摔手机壳，L1 手机数码、L2 手机配件，leaf 记磁吸无线充电透明防摔手机壳，与提示类目一致。已剥离内容：一切机型名与厂商标识（写通用 Pro 机型轮廓）、6.9/6.3/6.5 寸数、1.5mm、0.05 英寸、3200+、10FT、0%、军规与测试主张、锁屏时间与壁纸（一律改空白暗屏）、图标英文字注、账号与平台字样，全部改为空胶囊/空标尺/空图注轨/空勾叉盘与 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位；适配对照保留一勾三叉结构但机型改通用剪影。与库内膜类两套（石墨黑+雾白、深空蓝+冷银）区隔：本套以深板蓝舞台+信号橙字+青色磁吸光环为独有骨架。源图 7 张，逐图一镜排为 7 镜。
